name: simmer
title: Simmer
description: Control the Simmer battery charge limiter: see the battery status, set the charge limit, top up, discharge, pause and toggle the limiter.
author: umarwaseeem

preferences.name: simmerctlPath
preferences.title: simmerctl Path
preferences.description: Where the Simmer command-line tool is installed. The Simmer app installs it with its helper.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Battery Status
commands.subtitle: Simmer
commands.description: Show the battery level, charging state, limit, power flow and health.

commands.name: top-up
commands.title: Charge to 100% Once
commands.subtitle: Simmer
commands.description: Charge to 100% once, then go back to the limit. Run it again to stop.

commands.name: discharge
commands.title: Discharge to Limit
commands.subtitle: Simmer
commands.description: Run from the battery down to the limit while plugged in. Run it again to stop.

commands.name: pause
commands.title: Pause Charging Here
commands.subtitle: Simmer
commands.description: Set the charge limit to the current battery percentage.

commands.name: toggle-limiter
commands.title: Toggle Charge Limiter
commands.subtitle: Simmer
commands.description: Turn the charge limiter on or off.
